scenarios.title: Sales Head sets monthly targets
scenarios.summary: Happy path: target by value and by product group quantity; agent is told.

steps.action: Sets the November target for a Sales Agent by value and by quantity per product group
Gets a push that a target is set and sees own target only

scenarios.title: Manager reads Target vs Achievement
scenarios.summary: Achievement is Invoiced and Delivered orders before VAT; Cancelled not counted.

steps.action: Opens Target vs Achievement for own area and exports to Excel
Opens Visit Productivity: visits with an order are productive, others show the No-order reason

scenarios.title: Incentive at month end
scenarios.summary: 2% at 100% or more of target, 1% at 80 to 99%, none below; no target gives no incentive.

steps.action: Opens the Incentive report: agent at 100% shows 2%, at 85% shows 1%, at 70% none, no target shows No target
Opens the Performance dashboard and the Efficiency dashboard

scenarios.title: Debt and daily summary
scenarios.summary: Debt is SAP open balances plus credit invoices minus collections; Supervisor cannot open it.

steps.action: Opens Debt vs Collection; the SAP part can be 30 minutes old
Sees Daily Sales for yesterday on top of the dashboard and filters by beat

scenarios.title: Heat map with a customer without GEO
scenarios.summary: Exception: a customer without GEO is not on the map.

steps.action: Opens the Customer Master Heat Map, clicks a customer for name, Category and last-30-days sales; a customer without GEO is missing

scenarios.title: Report views per day unknown
scenarios.summary: Open Item: how many people open reports a day.
